up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are referenced by the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1133512. For each such molecule, provide its molecule ChEMBL ID, its preferred compound name, and its canonical SMILES. Only include molecules for which a canonical SMILES is present (not null). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES, all in ascending order. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133512' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles
